easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least 5.
description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Ulasht. Ulasht enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ulasht using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
